record.title: Mauritania restrictions on entry from Mali during April 2024 border tensions
record.scope: Selective entry restrictions and reported transit interruption; not a verified total bilateral closure
record.crossings: Koki Zamal named in the early report; later EFE report covers entry from Mali more broadly
record.direction: Best-supported direction is Mali into Mauritania; complete outbound closure is not established.
record.movement: Malian entrants without accepted authorisation; buses and trucks were affected at Koki Zamal in the early account.
record.exceptions: EFE reports entry for Malian residents or holders of written authorisation; an earlier account says some permit holders were nevertheless refused.
record.imposing_authority: Mauritanian border authorities, according to local-source reporting
record.enforcement: Local sources report refusals at the frontier.
record.consequences: Interrupted transit at Koki Zamal; broader economic effects not independently quantified.
record.relationship: No matching closure in the 495-record audited baseline. Separate from Mali’s 2020/2022 national sanctions regimes.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; not a present-day status assessment
record.official_rationale: No official closure rationale located. Security is an analytical classification of the reported context.
record.context: Restrictions followed reported incursions and attacks involving Malian forces and Russian personnel. Government reporting later confirms official concern for border security.
record.uncertainty: Onset reports differ: about two days before 17 April versus roughly two weeks before 25 April. Month precision retained. Scope and authorisation practice may have evolved; neither source establishes a total closure or verified end.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty. Restriction evidenced in April 2024 and on 25 April specifically; exact onset and reopening unknown.
